_note: IT-08: factual defects I041-I050 (A04-01, A04-04, A04-05, A04-06 + A02-02 + A03-12, A04-07). Block notes by partial edit, comments by full text with an expect guard.

edit.find: The old text ('four tile entries flanking the hit position', 'spawned during inventory-screen hit feedback') is wrong: it writes two compose-buffer entries per frame and its only spawn site is GiveItemToPlayer.
edit.with: It writes two compose-buffer entries per frame and its only spawn site is GiveItemToPlayer.

edit.find: The child copies position from the actor whose slot is in X when the item is given (the in-line comment there says the player; not verified). No item id of $86 or more was found in the chest tables or GiveItem operands of extracted/, so whether this path is reachable in the shipped game is open (OQ-I042-1).
edit.with: The child copies its position from the spawner: GiveItemToPlayer sets D := X before the spawn (PHD / TXA / TCD), so the sparkle appears at the actor whose slot is in X when the item is given. Item id $86 is reachable: DropBodyHeal5 in EnemyDropSystem stores $0086 in chatPtr (rows 00, 06 and 0B of drop_threshold_by_hp select it, one row per HP tier), and when the player overlaps that pickup (flag $0020 in its $10) combat_collision.InteractionDamage_NPCChat runs TYX and calls GiveItemToPlayer with chatPtr, so the sparkle appears at the pickup actor.

edit.find: $0100 = the scan offset after a hit, $0102 = a 16-bit copy of the stack top (the bank byte plus the low byte of the pointer).
edit.with: $0100 = the hit offset + 1 (the offset of the $BF signature byte: the INY after the operand read runs before TYA / STA $0100), $0102 = a 16-bit copy of the stack top (the bank byte plus the low byte of the pointer). The scan resumes at the hit offset + 4, the Y that PHY pushes after three more INY.

778768.text: $0100 = hit offset + 1 (Y after the INY above); the resume offset, hit + 4, is pushed later by PHY
